cases.sentence: Я словно тот, кто после сбора летних ___, после уборки винограда.
cases.translation: I am like one who gathers summer fruits after the harvest of grapes.
cases.explain: After the verb сбора (harvest/gathering) in possessive meaning, the genitive case is used.

cases.sentence: Исчезли верные на ___. Нет праведных среди людей.
cases.translation: The godly have vanished from the earth. There are no righteous among men.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) governing location takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Their hands are skilled to do evil.
cases.explain: The direct object of the transitive verb творить (to do/create), which takes accusative; for neuter nouns, accusative equals nominative.

cases.translation: The ruler demands gifts; the judge accepts bribes.
cases.explain: Судья is the subject of the predicate, standing in the nominative case.

cases.translation: Do not rely on a neighbor.
cases.explain: The preposition на with meaning 'on/upon' in negative imperative context governs accusative case here.

cases.sentence: Сын позорит ___, дочь восстает против матери, и невестка против свекрови.
cases.translation: The son dishonors his father, the daughter rises up against her mother, and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
cases.explain: The transitive verb позорит (to dishonor) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Я буду взирать на _____, ждать Бога спасения моего.
cases.translation: But I will look to the Lord; I will wait for the God of my salvation.
cases.explain: The preposition на governing direction of gaze (взирать на) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Пусть во мраке сижу, светом будет мне ___.
cases.translation: When I sit in darkness, the Lord will be a light to me.
cases.explain: The predicate noun stands in nominative case after the copula будет.

reading.ru: Исчезли верные на земле. Нет праведных среди людей. Все сидят в засаде, чтобы пролить кровь.
reading.question: What is the state of righteousness among people according to this verse?
options: The righteous have disappeared and all scheme to shed blood
The righteous are many and peaceful
reading.correct: The righteous have disappeared and all scheme to shed blood
reading.explain: The text states Исчезли верные на земле, Нет праведных среди людей, и Все сидят в засаде, чтобы пролить кровь — the faithful have vanished, there are no righteous among men, and all lie in wait to spill blood.

reading.ru: Не полагайтесь на ближнего, не доверяйте другу. Даже с той, что лежит в твоих объятиях, будь осторожен в словах.
reading.question: What warning is given about trust and relationships?
options: Do not trust even your closest companions; be careful in your speech
Trust your neighbor and your friends completely
Share all your secrets with those close to you
Be bold and open with everyone
reading.correct: Do not trust even your closest companions; be careful in your speech
reading.explain: The text warns: Не полагайтесь на ближнего, не доверяйте другу... будь осторожен в словах — Don't trust a neighbor, don't confide in a friend, be careful in your words.

reading.ru: Сын позорит отца, дочь восстает против матери, и невестка против свекрови. Врагами человека станут его домашние.
reading.question: What does this verse describe about family relationships?
options: Children dishonor parents, and family members become enemies
Families support and love each other
reading.correct: Children dishonor parents, and family members become enemies
reading.explain: The text states Сын позорит отца, дочь восстает против матери, и невестка против свекрови. Врагами человека станут его домашние — Son disgraces father, daughter rebels against mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man's enemies are those of his own household.

reading.ru: Пусть во мраке сижу, светом будет мне Господь. Я согрешил перед Ним, потому я должен нести гнев Господень, пока Он не разрешит мое дело и не оправдает меня.
reading.question: Despite darkness and sin, what does the speaker expect?
options: The Lord will be light, and will vindicate him after bearing God's wrath
God will punish him forever without mercy
He will find light through his own efforts
reading.correct: The Lord will be light, and will vindicate him after bearing God's wrath
reading.explain: The text affirms светом будет мне Господь (the Lord will be light for me), and that eventually Он не разрешит мое дело и не оправдает меня (He will settle my case and vindicate me).

reading.ru: Как в те дни, когда ты вышел из Египта, я покажу тебе свои чудеса.
reading.question: What does God promise to show in the days ahead?
options: The same marvelous things as when bringing them out of Egypt
reading.correct: The same marvelous things as when bringing them out of Egypt
reading.explain: The text says Как в те дни, когда ты вышел из Египта, я покажу тебе свои чудеса — As in the days when you came out of Egypt, I will show them my marvelous things.

reading.ru: Спаси своим посохом народ свой, отару наследие твоего, что живет одиноко в зарослях, а вокруг плодородные пастбища.
reading.question: How is God's people described in this verse?
options: As a flock living alone in a forest surrounded by fertile pasture
As a large and powerful nation
As an army ready for battle
reading.correct: As a flock living alone in a forest surrounded by fertile pasture
reading.explain: The text describes отару наследие твоего, что живет одиноко в зарослях, а вокруг плодородные пастбища — the flock of your heritage living alone in a thicket, with fertile pasture land around.
